question.value: Do 0.1 pc cores and filaments in the 30Dor-10 cloud in the LMC resemble those in other clouds in structure, dynamics, stability and mass function, given strong external feedback from R136?

evidence.quote: To develop any universal understanding of star formation it is important to determine whether the same core and filament structures exist in a wider range of molecular clouds than exist in the solar neighborhood.

evidence.quote: There is a modest effect that the calculated column density (and mass) of bright structures may be overestimated by up to a factor of 2 relative to faint structures.

analysis_steps.goal: Segment emission into cores, hierarchical structures and filaments

method.value: quickclump (clumpfind-type), astrodendro, filfinder on the peak intensity image; filaments matched to elongated dendrogram structures

evidence.quote: we match filament branches to elongated dendrogram entities.

key_parameters.value: filfinder global threshold 0.17 (12CO) and 0.07 (13CO) of peak; flatten at 90%; smooth 3 beamwidths; size threshold 24 beam areas; adaptive threshold 14 beamwidths; prune 5 beams and 10 pixels; aspect ratio >2.5:1, area 0.2-0.5 pc^2

evidence.quote: Filaments are found using a global threshold of 0.17 and 0.07 times the peak intensity for $^{12}$CO and $^{13}$CO, respectively.

validation.value: Visual check; 3D vs 2D pruning gives only minor differences

evidence.quote: Our trials found that the final filament skeletons differ only in minor ways between the default 3D pruning and pruning based on 3D lengths

analysis_steps.goal: Filament velocity gradients, line mass, stability and width

method.value: Moment-1 gradient vs filament direction; line mass from Gaussian fit to perpendicular profile or integrated N, compared with critical line mass 2sigma^2/G with thermal and nonthermal support

evidence.quote: Unmagnetized isothermal filaments with line mass i.e. mass per unit length $M_l > 2\sigma^2/G$ are unstable to gravitational collapse

key_parameters.value: mu = 2.36 m_H; sigma_v over cube within 5 km/s of filament peak velocity

evidence.quote: where $\mu$ is the mean molecular mass 2.36$m_H$
